data.name: Silurian Planet
data.detailed_description:
Silurian Planet offers you an experience of survival, exploration, and environmental horror in a desolate and threatening world. Your worst enemy will be in the sky, but it won't be the only one.

Surtum, the incandescent moon.

As beautiful as it is lethal, Surtum is a moon that orbits very close to this planet with a very short period. Every time it passes over you, it causes environmental disturbances that can kill you but can also save you… if you act intelligently. You will have to adapt to these phenomena to survive, explore, and escape.

Your objective.

After the failure of the initial mission, your goal will be to reach the rescue point, using safe zones to hide from Surtum's passage. Every decision can be crucial: carefully choose when to advance and when to take shelter. But beware, in these shelters, you will not always be alone. Stay alert to the threats lurking in the darkness.

The remains of a lost world.

The planet holds the remains of lost civilizations that met an apocalyptic end. What creatures built this? What remains of them? What happened on this planet that, every so often, is ravaged by the passage of a deadly moon? Your journey will lead you to a disturbing ending that will not leave you indifferent.

Morgana, your AI companion.

During your adventure, you will have the help of Morgana, an advanced artificial intelligence integrated into your helmet. Morgana will assist you in the exploration and document the places you travel, helping you understand the history of this devastated planet.

data.short_description: Silurian Planet is a first-person survival horror game. Survive on a hostile and oppressive planet, seek shelter, manage resources, and make decisions to escape creatures lurking in the darkness.
